rows.label: qst200217_msg0001
rows.name:
Looks like Harhal will use Luxuria
as a base to smuggle Pollen Orbs
to other countries.

rows.label: qst200217_msg0003
rows.name:
Luxuria only just opened its borders,
after all.

rows.label: qst200217_msg0004
rows.name:
Since import routes aren't
established, even suspicious
goods may be hard to trace.

rows.label: qst200217_msg0005
rows.name:
They're a hundred years too early
to try that in my country!

rows.label: qst200217_msg0006
rows.name:
Harhal will probably come to
receive the cargo at Genbu Port.
We'll catch her at the scene!

rows.label: qst200217_msg0007
rows.name:
[ML:Feeling kind=Anger ]Uooooooh!
I'll round up every last petty crook
who's gotten involved in smuggling!
